'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Insurgency in the Maghreb (2002–present)|Insurgency in the Maghreb]]
**[[2021 Niger attacks]]
***Gunmen attack a military outpost in the village of Anzourou, [[Tillabéri Region]], [[Niger]], killing fifteen soldiers. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/least-11-soldiers-killed-attack-southwest-niger-sources-say-2021-11-05/ (Reuters)]
*[[Tigray War]]
**Nine factions opposed to the government of [[Prime Minister of Ethiopia|Prime Minister]] [[Abiy Ahmed]] form a political and military alliance "to reverse the harmful effects of the Abiy Ahmed rule on the peoples of Ethiopia and beyond". [https://www.dw.com/en/ethiopia-tigray-and-anti-government-groups-form-alliance/a-59729050 (DW)]
**The [[United States]] urges its citizens to leave [[Ethiopia]] "as soon as possible", as rebels advance on the capital [[Addis Ababa]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/ethiopia-news-travel-advice-us-citizens-b1952311.html (''The Independent'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economy of Brazil]]
**The Ministry of Economy announces a measure to decrease the price of importation tariffs by 10%, amid an increase in inflation, which reached two digits in [[Brazil]]. The [[government of Brazil|government]] also argued that the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil|COVID-19 pandemic in the country]] has increased the prices of food. [https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mercado/2021/11/governo-corta-taxas-de-importacao-em-10-e-guedes-defende-choque-de-oferta-para-conter-inflacao.shtml (Folha)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Freetown fuel tanker explosion]]
**At least 99 people are killed and more than 100 injured by a [[tank truck|fuel truck]] [[colliding]] with a [[truck]] causing an explosion in [[Freetown]], [[Sierra Leone]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/fuel-tanker-blast-sierra-leone-capital-kills-least-91-says-morgue-2021-11-06/ (Reuters)]
*[[Astroworld Festival crowd crush]]
**Eight people are dead and hundreds more are injured during a [[stampede]] and [[crowd crush]] at the [[Astroworld Festival|Astroworld Music Festival]] in [[Houston]], [[Texas]], [[United States]]. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2021/11/06/travis-scott-concert-multiple-deaths-crowd-surge-texas-festival/6315736001/ (''USA Today'')]
*[[2021 Piedade de Caratinga Beechcraft King Air crash]]
**A plane crashes in [[Minas Gerais]], [[Brazil]], killing all five people on board, including singer [[Marília Mendonça]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-59186654 (BBC News)]
*[[2021 floods in Bosnia and Herzegovina]]
**Heavy rain causes [[flash flood]]s in [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]], with evacuations, power outages, water-submerged roads, and the closing of an oxygen facility used for [[COVID-19]] patients. [https://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/health/flash-floods-in-bosnia-prompt-evacuations-power-outages/ (Seattle Times)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Germany]]
*****[[Federal Ministry of Health (Germany)|German Health minister]] [[Jens Spahn]] and regional health ministers agree to offer [[booster dose]]s of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]] for all vaccinated people amid a fourth wave of the pandemic. [https://www.dw.com/en/covid-germany-to-offer-booster-shots-for-all/a-59732676 (DW)]
****[[Germany]] reports a record for the second consecutive day of 37,120 new cases of COVID-19. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-11-05/german-cases-hit-fresh-record-as-fourth-wave-spreads-in-europe (Bloomberg)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Austria]]
****The [[Austria]]n [[Government of Austria|government]] announces that it will ban people who are [[COVID-19 vaccination in Austria|unvaccinated]] and those who have not recovered from COVID-19 from entering cafes, restaurants, hairdressers, hotels, events with more than 25 people, and ski lifts beginning on 8 November due to an increase in COVID-19 cases. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/austria-bans-unvaccinated-cafes-hairdressers-covid-19-cases-surge-2021-11-05/ (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Croatia]]
****[[Croatia]] reports a record for the second consecutive day of 6,932 new cases of COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 490,074. [https://rs.n1info.com/english/news/coronavirus-croatia-reports-a-new-all-time-high-in-daily-cases/ (N1)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
****[[Greece]] reports a record for the second consecutive day of 6,909 new cases of COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 774,265. [https://www.ekathimerini.com/news/1171221/covid-new-record-high-of-6-909-cases-48-deaths-and-450-intubated/ (''Ekathimerini'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Northern Territory]]
*****[[Katherine, Northern Territory|Katherine]] enters a [[COVID-19 lockdown|lockdown]] after the [[Northern Territory]] records its first locally-transmitted infection since the beginning of the pandemic. In [[Darwin, Northern Territory|Greater Darwin]], unvaccinated residents are told to lockdown while fully vaccinated residents are exempt with the exception of being required to wear a mask. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-11-04/covid-case-katherine-lockdown-darwin-lockout/100596256 (ABC News Australia)]
****[[New South Wales]] and [[Victoria (Australia)|Victoria]] reopen their internal borders as more than 80% of both states' populations are [[COVID-19 vaccine|fully vaccinated]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2021/nov/04/nsw-and-victoria-to-open-border-for-fully-vaccinated-from-midnight (''The Guardian'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand]]
****[[New Zealand]] reports a record 163 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. [https://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/covid-19-delta-outbreak-163-new-cases-highest-daily-infection-rate-since-outbreak/NT6EAX4WQI77ACXNPX4YEOQQLI/ (''New Zealand Herald'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Metro Manila]]
****The [[Inter-Agency Task Force for the Management of Emerging Infectious Diseases]] places the [[Metro Manila|National Capital Region]] into the lesser restriction of Alert Level 2 beginning today due to a decrease in the number of cases in the area. This will allow for the resumption of limited face-to-face classes, [[nightlife]], and increased operations of government departments and agencies. [https://www.rappler.com/nation/metro-manila-alert-level-2-november-5-21-2021 (Rappler)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Colorado]]
****Two [[hyena]]s at [[Denver Zoo]] test positive for COVID-19, marking the first time the virus has infected that animal worldwide. [https://thehill.com/homenews/state-watch/580364-hyenas-at-denver-zoo-test-positive-for-covid-19 (''The Hill'')]
**[[COVID-19 drug development]]
***A late-stage trial of the [[oral drug]] [[Paxlovid]] conducted by [[Pfizer]] shows an 89% reduction in hospitalizations and deaths. [https://www.ft.com/content/848cce54-0d47-4488-b829-5539abddcf6e (''Financial Times'')]
*[[Climate change]]
**Researchers from [[James Cook University]] report that 98% of the [[Great Barrier Reef]] has been affected by [[coral bleaching]] as a result of climate change, which is more than was previously thought to have been affected. [https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2021/nov/05/great-barrier-reefs-future-dealt-blow-as-study-finds-only-2-escaped-coral-bleaching (''The Guardian'')]
**A protest is organized by [[Fridays for Future]] during the [[2021 United Nations Climate Change Conference]] in [[Glasgow]], with Swedish activist [[Greta Thunberg]] delivering a speech. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/climate-environment/2021/11/05/cop26-climate-protests-live-updates/ (''The Washington Post'')] [https://www.independent.co.uk/climate-change/new/cop26-glasgow-news-live-updates-today-b1951977.html (''The Independent'')]
*[[2020–2021 H5N8 outbreak]]
**[[France]] issues a nationwide high alert that requires all [[poultry]] farms to keep their flocks indoors, requires daily clinical monitoring of all farms, and enhanced conditions for bird transport, due to the spread of the current [[bird flu]] outbreak. [https://www.politico.eu/article/france-goes-on-high-alert-for-bird-flu/ (''Politico'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]], [[Vaccine passports during the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**Despite opposition from the predominantly right-wing [[Senate (France)|senate]], the [[National Assembly (France)|National Assembly]] votes 118 to 89 to extend public health measures related to COVID-19, including the extension of Health Pass with its tightened sanctions against fraud, until 31 July 2022. [https://www.thelocal.fr/20211105/french-health-pass-rule-to-be-extended-to-july-2022/ (''The Local France'')]
*It is revealed that a [[Russia]]n diplomat was found dead outside the [[Embassy of Russia, Berlin|country's embassy]] in [[Berlin]], [[Germany]], on October 19. The diplomat had apparently fallen from an upper floor, but it was unclear how this occurred. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-59175317 (BBC News)]
